current_refusal: PlanError: physical HBM plan requires 548500668416 bytes per node, capability provides 103079215104

reading: 215,545,920,480 B of weights are REPLICATED on every node, dominated by the two Engram row tables (98,308,270,592 + 98,305,579,008) and their e8m0 scale planes; the shipped chip has 103,079,215,104 B of HBM per node, so the table alone does not fit on one node and must be row- or column-sharded across the cluster.  That is the same open item the wafer/array lane records as 'the array placer's ownership of a row-sharded HBM table'

319,278,673,928 B of activation arena, of which 206,158,430,208 B is two slots of 262,144 x 262,144: the INDEX_SCORE output and the candidate-pool admission plane read per token.  This is results/abi3/deepseek_v41_hbm_comparator_plan.json#known_gaps 'block-max-context-axis-not-resolved-by-a-loop' -- the context axis is planned at the span maximum.  Naming the operator in CONTEXT_LOOP_OPS is not sufficient: VECTOR.INDEX_SCORE is already named there and the ARENA SLOT is still sized at the span maximum, so the fix is in arena sizing, not in the loop set

dtype_amendment.simulator_quantiser_agreement: 600 of 600 random 16-element BF16 groups agree code-for-code with runtime.reference.fp4_kv.quantize_to_fp4 (elements and E4M3 scale); the all-zero group emits scale code 0 and zero elements, as the reference does

other_backend_gaps_closed.refusal: PlanError: kernel main.layer02.attention.indexer.key_write: destination-row map 'compressed_group_index' is not one of absolute_position, absolute_position_mod_window, completed_absolute_position_floor_div_ratio
other_backend_gaps_closed.resolution: CACHE_ROW_ALIASES maps it to completed_absolute_position_floor_div_ratio.  Evidence, not assumption: the V4 export names the long spelling and the V4.1 export the short one on kernels carrying the SAME numeric contract compressed_kv_write_bf16_v1, whose one reference is runtime.reference.compressed_kv.compressed_kv_write_bf16, both with a positive ratio and a destination extent of context_length // ratio rows

other_backend_gaps_closed.refusal: PlanError: kernel main.layer00.attention.sparse: ATTENTION.SPARSE must declare its block width
other_backend_gaps_closed.resolution: read from the CONTRACT, not the model: both graphs name sparse_attention_bf16_v1 and runtime/reference/sparse_attention.py declares SPARSE_ATTENTION_BLOCK_SIZE = 64 as a module constant.  The kernel attribute still wins where present, so V4 is unchanged

other_backend_gaps_closed.refusal: PlanError: kernel main.final_norm: HEAD_RMS_NORM must declare its head count in aux0
other_backend_gaps_closed.resolution: derived, not defaulted: the iteration domain's width is the reduction group and the principal operand's last dimension is the row; when the row is a whole number of groups the head count is their quotient, and 5120 // 5120 = 1 for the final norm.  A ragged or absent pair still refuses

other_backend_gaps_closed.refusal: PlanError: main.layer20.attention.compressor.project (COMPRESS_PROJECT): binds 2 input views where VECTOR.8 requires 3
other_backend_gaps_closed.resolution: OPTIONAL_INPUT_SLOTS gains COMPRESS_PROJECT slot 2, and the backend honours it only when the kernel declares projections == 1 (SRC-DSV41-FLASH-MODEL: a ratio-1 compressor is a plain BF16 projection, with no gate).  A gated compressor that bound two operands is still a fault
